achievements.title: Projects
achievements.description.critertec: Educational tech agency. As Systems Administrator, I operate and secure the infrastructure that keeps its digital solutions running in production.
achievements.description.soyDigital: Dominican Government portal (INDOTEL) for developing digital skills at national scale. I built the offline frontend with automatic sync so field registration worked even without a stable connection.
achievements.description.indieLevels: Video game studio in Medellín building titles for clients worldwide. As Backend Developer I developed and maintained the studio's product services and APIs (Jun 2021 — Sep 2025).
achievements.description.humanizar: Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS ecosystem I built: e-commerce (Graf), point-of-sale with DIAN e-invoicing (Sinergia POS), credit fintech (FIAR), and messaging, orchestrated with NestJS microservices.
achievements.description.cafeteriadelcao: Cafeteria is an intellectual virtual community on Discord.
achievements.description.agora: AI-agent SaaS platform I built as a poly-repo of separate services (Next.js frontend, Cloud Run backend, a real-time socket.io hub and Docker workers) to isolate concerns and deploy each part independently. Design decisions: an extensible tool registry, BYOK, typed contracts validated with Zod, secrets encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and a custom MCP server. Deployed and running.
achievements.description.emw: WhatsApp Business marketing-automation platform (NestJS + MySQL + Redis): campaigns and mass messaging.
